detekt/detekt#8676 (by BraisGabin): Rename `md` report to `markdown`
It is the same idea as #8471. The name of the report shouldn't be the extension of the file but the format.

This point was pointed out by @3flex at https://github.com/detekt/detekt/pull/8595#discussion_r2361774893

He also pointed out this:

> Also, at the risk of starting an unhelpful discussion, should this actually be `commonmark`? We use code fences in the output, which is not part of Markdown syntax.

I agree that we could call it `commonmark` too but I don't think we should. Everyone calls it `markdown` and we don't want to support `githubmark` nor any other flavor. So I would vote to call it `markdown`.
